data.gist: MSCs are rare (0.001–0.01% of nucleated cells) and large-volume aspiration dilutes marrow with peripheral blood, lowering yield and possibly harming MSCs.
data.plain: BMAC aims to concentrate stem cells, but they make up only a tiny fraction of marrow cells. Drawing large volumes (typically over 120 mL) pulls in peripheral blood, giving diminishing cell returns, and red blood cells and their released contents may harm MSCs.
